evals.prompt: 帮我用 TypePHP 起一个新项目，做一个命令行小工具：读一个 CSV 文件，按某列分组统计总和，把结果按数值降序打印出来。放在 D:/Temp/eval-cli 下，最后要能编译成 exe 跑起来。
evals.expected_output: A working TypePHP project at D:/Temp/eval-cli with project.yml + src/, code that compiles (real build, not just --dry), and a binary that actually runs on a sample CSV. Agent should have checked TypePHP restrictions before writing, used the universal-method / std container idioms, avoided global-scope executable statements, and reported which verification rungs it reached (including whether the runtime DLL dependency matters).

evals.prompt: 我这段 TypePHP 代码 check_code 一直是 OK，但编译出来的程序一跑就报 `class 'OrderRepo' is undefined`，怎么回事？文件在 D:/Temp/eval-debug/src/main.php，同目录还有个 OrderRepo.php。帮我修好并确认能跑。
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies that undefined symbols resolve at runtime so check_code (--dry) cannot see them, finds the actual cause (file not included in the compiled set / wrong input shape / single-file input), fixes it, and re-verifies by actually building and running — not by re-running check_code. Should explain why a green check was not evidence.

evals.prompt: 把 D:/Temp/eval-port/app.php 这段普通 PHP 改写成能过 TypePHP 编译的版本。它用了 Composer 的 autoload、几个 array_* 函数、还有一段全局的初始化代码。
evals.expected_output: Agent consults list_restrictions/search_docs before editing, rewrites global executable code into functions/main(), replaces autoload/global init with the TypePHP-appropriate approach, keeps array operations working (universal methods or plain functions), and verifies with real compile+run rather than only check_code. Should flag anything that is a genuine limit rather than silently working around it.
